name: three-d-carousel
title: 3D Carousel
description: A rotating cylinder of square photos that you drag sideways to spin; clicking a photo stops the carousel and opens that image large in an overlay.
use: You want an explorable photo gallery that feels physical and can open a single shot on click.
avoid: There is no keyboard or button control; on touch a stray drag spins it, and it needs a wide container.
a11y: No keyboard control and no reduced-motion handling; alt text is a placeholder like keyword_0 plus the raw URL. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On a near-black stage, a row of square photos stands around an invisible cylinder, tilted by perspective at both edges. Each photo sits on a dark rounded tile with a small gap between tiles.
behaves: Dragging sideways spins the drum and a spring carries it after release; clicking a photo pauses it and grows the image in an overlay, and clicking the overlay closes it.
customise: Photos are a fixed internal Unsplash list; changing images or keywords means editing the source, and the component accepts no props.
weight: moderate: A dozen large photos plus drag and spring motion; no per-frame loop.
